steps.instruction: Try dragging with your mouse to look around the shape.
steps.hint: Click and hold anywhere on the screen, then move your mouse.

steps.instruction: See the diamond shape? Move your mouse over one of its flat faces.
steps.hint: Any of the 12 flat sides works — just hover over one.

steps.instruction: Click that face to place a new block there.

completionMessage: That's the whole build tool — hover a face, click, and keep going. You've got it.
